items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: it was little George Finola that was in the car, and Hillard is in the front with Murphy.

ctx.x: want to say nothing. And he packs the drums and calls a cab and hauls him out to the South Side, 1800 or somewhere, where some gangsters, where he can go to work as a bartender, which is what he did, and just put the drums down.

And we didn't find out til later what it was, that it was this conversation that was driving him up the wall. And an interesting story about this is that, years later, it was little George Finola that was in the car, and Hillard is in the front with Murphy.
He was driving with Don Murphy?
